source.title: Organising a food-bank volunteer shift
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: The coordinator will set aside a short briefing before the food-bank opens on Saturday. New volunteers will learn where to store donated goods and how to look after chilled items. During the first hour, a team leader will hand out labels and assign each person a shelf to check. At the end of the shift, volunteers will record low-stock items so the next team can prepare an order.
